overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance reveals that relationship dynamic themes, specifically husband-wife emotional realities (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए'), significantly outperform general sad shayaris or niche family content. These top performers secured over 1,600+ views compared to the baseline 100-300 views. General poetry and generic sad quotes fail to capture attention.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on married life dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') achieved 1,767 and 1,674 views respectively, outperforming all other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship dilemmas, unspoken expectations, and emotional distance after marriage.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' gained only 17 views due to overly abstract and poetic phrasing that lacks an immediate everyday visual anchor.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic rants; ground every video in a specific, everyday micro-moment.

experiment: Testing if shifting the husband-wife emotional dynamic from overt arguments to subtle post-marriage silent habits yields higher engagement and comments.
